shared: Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished panoramic, full-bleed editorial illustration for one card in the German Quizsalon, a cultural general-knowledge magazine game for adults. Wide horizontal composition, about 2:1. Beautiful mid-century European illustrated book jacket / lithographic travel-poster craftsmanship: rich opaque gouache color fields, precise economical carved marks, subtle matte paper grain, natural proportions and well-chosen light. Its sister illustrations share deep pine green shadows, warm ivory highlights and one distinctive accent. Visually readable at 160 pixels wide. Give the primary subject a decisive silhouette in the middle two thirds. Carry the entire scene right to all four edges. One continuous picture, no mat, no painted border, no white margins, no text, no legible letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no graphic overlays.

scenes.nature_animals: A single European kingfisher perched on a slender diagonal willow branch above a jade-green river, looking left. The cobalt and copper plumage and sharp black beak catch soft daylight. Reeds and quiet ripples in the soft midground; tightly composed, with the whole little bird and branch unmistakable. Emerald, muted teal, and burnt orange.
scenes.geography_travel: A small red passenger train on a low curved stone viaduct winding beside a turquoise alpine lake. An unbroken mountain ridge and two faraway snowy peaks lead the eye through receding layers. Broad view, one recognisable train in the middle distance, no lettering on the carriages. Larch-green hills, cool lake blue and a restrained coral accent.
scenes.everyday_technology: A close observation of a timeless bicycle headlamp and bottle dynamo beside the front tire of a real city bicycle. The rounded enamel and chrome headlamp faces three quarters toward us and glows a gentle amber. A few clean radial spokes and a dark green mudguard articulate the wheel; subdued workshop wall behind. Designed as a tactile mechanical still life with large, legible forms. Pine enamel, brass, golden ochre and charcoal.
scenes.history_discoveries: An archaeological dig uncovering an intact ancient Greek red-figure terracotta amphora, its tall two-handled silhouette and single simple painted figure clear. Cropped low trench of sand and stone, a soft broad excavation brush in the foreground, a sunlit Mediterranean ridge in the far background. Noble and curious, not a pile of props. Terracotta and clay ochre against deep warm umber and olive.
scenes.entertainment: A classic two-reel cinema projector in near profile, casting one soft pale beam across a dark small movie theater. Its twin metal reels, glass lens and a band of burgundy velvet seats are readable at thumbnail size. The projector is the one hero subject; subtle grain and reflected light on the housing. Oxblood, plum-black, and warm projection gold.
scenes.language_culture: A large open cream book with an illuminated botanical woodcut on one page and a simple ornamental illuminated initial shape on the facing page, with a glossy midnight-green fountain pen placed diagonally across its lower edge. Suggest the traditions of literature and book arts; all page details are abstract engraving and tiny nonverbal marks, no readable writing. Close-up on an aubergine and walnut reading desk, warm raking window light, subtle oxblood binding and muted plum shadow. Hero objects fill the composition.
